door_unheard.title: {name} does not call Home Assistant
door_unheard.description:
Home Assistant has not heard the VoIP line of {name} for more than 11 minutes, so its button does not ring here.

In the web page of the door station, under the VoIP (SIP) settings: enable the line, set the server to `{address}` and the port to `{port}`, and set the audio to G.711 only. The SIP registration sensor turns on when the door station registers; this issue then goes away.

phone_gone.title: A phone of {name} left Home Assistant

confirm.title: Remove {phone} from {name}
confirm.description:
The phone {phone}, an extension of {name}, is no longer a device of Home Assistant (its app was removed or signed out), so it cannot ring.

Select **Submit** to remove it from {name}. Once its app is back, add it again with **Add phone**.
